title: Master Rāga Encyclopedia & Emotional Taxonomy Database
description: Exhaustive musicological, psychological, and acoustic catalog of Carnatic Ragas (all 72 Melakartas + Janya, Vakra, Ghana, and Bhashanga Ragas), defining Swarasthana Blueprints, Rasas, Bhavas, Gamakas, Time, Deities, Compositions, and Scholarly References.

treatise_bibliography.TR-01: N. S. Ramachandran (1938), 'The Ragas of Karnatic Music', University of Madras.
treatise_bibliography.TR-02: Dr. S. Ramanathan & D. Pattammal (1984), 'Raga Pravagam'.

navarasa_definitions.Vira: Valor, Heroism, Majesty, Regal Vigor (Utsāha Stāyī-bhāva)
navarasa_definitions.Adbhuta: Wonder, Mystical Awe, Cosmic Marvel (Vismaya Stāyī-bhāva)
navarasa_definitions.Raudra: Fury, Righteous Wrath, Dramatic Force (Krōdha Stāyī-bhāva)
